theme_strategy: Supports both light and dark modes with a smooth, professional aesthetic.

archetype.name: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast
archetype.description: Professional, authoritative, clear, and highly functional. Color is used strictly for hierarchy, function, and shift-coding rather than decoration.

colors.sticky_notes: bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-900 border-yellow-200 dark:bg-yellow-900/50 dark:text-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-700 shadow-sm

spacing_and_layout.calendar_grid: Grid structure with strict borders, absolute positioning for overlapping sticky notes.

surface_strategies.header_and_presence_bar: Crystal Glassmorphism. Light: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-slate-200. Dark: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/60 border-b border-slate-800.
surface_strategies.widgets_and_cards: Neumorphism (Clay & Crisp). Flat background matching surface color, 1px subtle border, no heavy drop shadow by default.
surface_strategies.hover_states: Slight lift -translate-y-0.5, shadow-md, explicitly set hover text color.

components.presence_bar: Floating group of user avatars at the top right of the application shell (like Google Sheets). Avatars must overlap with -space-x-2 and have a 2px border matching the header background.
components.calendar: Custom grid overlay combining standard days with shift block cards. Shift blocks should be small, compact, using the shift_departments color tokens.
components.sticky_notes: Absolute positioned cards overlaid on top of the calendar grid. Slight rotation (rotate-1 or -rotate-1) to look organic, utilizing the sticky_notes color tokens.
components.data_tables: Used for Employee CRUD and Reports. Must use Shadcn tables, left-aligned headers, alternating row colors (subtle) for readability.

motion.micro_interactions: Buttons and shift blocks scale down slightly active:scale-95. Hover states reveal edit/swap icons on shift blocks.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize Shadcn/UI primitives for complex interactive components (Tables, Dropdowns, DatePickers, Dialogs). Do NOT build these from scratch.
Implement the 'Soft Utility' aesthetic: rounded-lg maximum, 1px solid borders for definition, avoid heavy shadows.
Use purely structural HTML/Tailwind for the calendar layout to ensure overlapping sticky notes work correctly. Use relative on the cell and absolute for the note.
Color-code the shifts clearly based on the department using the provided shift_departments tokens.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, shift blocks, swap requests) using the kebab-case role-based convention.
Ensure dark mode is fully functional using Tailwind 'dark:' prefix classes for all surfaces, borders, and text.
Use Phosphor Icons for this dense dashboard application to maintain a crisp, professional look. Install using: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
